links.outcome: Appropriateness of LLM-recommended musculoskeletal providers and hallucinated providers
links.effect: Appropriate: ChatGPT 17/17 (100%), Gemini 9/21 (43%), DeepSeek 4/10 (40%), P<0.001; 5 of 18 inappropriate recommendations were hallucinations, all from DeepSeek.
links.quote: Of the 18 inappropriate recommendations, 13 (72%) were real providers in unrelated specialties and 5 (28%) were hallucinations, all from DeepSeek.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs on their ability to recommend appropriate musculoskeletal providers from standardized patient queries, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
